data.one_liner: NFC functionality plugin for Android, iOS and Web, supporting NDEF records and APDU transceive.
data.what_it_does: Provides NFC tag and card reading/writing capabilities across multiple platforms. Supports metadata inspection, reading and writing NDEF records, block-level operations, and low-level transceive commands.
use_when: Your app needs to read or write NDEF records on NFC tags or smart cards.
You need to exchange raw commands or APDUs with ISO 7816 / ISO 14443 cards.
avoid_when: You are targeting web browsers that actually require true native NFC (the web version uses WebUSB instead).
You only need standard QR code or barcode scanning.
strengths: Supports multiple standards including ISO 14443, ISO 18092, ISO 15693, and ISO 7816.
Provides both polling and event streaming operation modes.
Cross-platform support for Android, iOS, and Web (via WebUSB).
weaknesses: Certain low-level features and operations are limited or platform-specific due to native API restrictions.
Requires manual native setup and permissions configuration on both Android and iOS.
data.setup_notes: Android requires NFC permissions and specific minimum SDK/Java versions. iOS requires enabling Near Field Communication Tag Reading capabilities, configuring Info.plist and entitlements.
